params.sigma: point-in-time SD of the home margin over all games before the date
params.status: all parameters and both team ratings use only games strictly earlier than the game being predicted

what_being_tested: Each play is graded against the probability the originated line itself implied. A strategy earns promotion only by winning MORE often than its own model said it would - which is the question a bookmaker would ask and the one a repository with no odds feed can still answer. A raw hit rate against 52.38% is deliberately not the headline: betting a strong favourite straight up clears that bar for free and proves nothing.

strategies.name: Model favourite, edge >= 5 pts
strategies.why_tested: does a wider band add anything

strategies.name: Model favourite, edge >= 3 pts
strategies.rule: Bet the favourite only when the projected margin is at least 3 points clear of the naive home-court line.
strategies.why_tested: the site's existing pick gate, re-tested on 160 games

strategies.name: Model favourite, any edge
strategies.rule: Bet the side the point-in-time rating model favours.

strategies.name: Home dog against a road favourite
strategies.rule: When the model likes the away side by 3+, take the home dog instead: the exact reverse of T02.
strategies.why_tested: is the model's confidence misplaced on road favourites

strategies.name: Three-leg parlay, edge >= 3
strategies.rule: The three strongest T02 legs on a date; all three must win.
strategies.why_tested: how fast a treble's true price moves away from the product of its legs

strategies.name: Two-leg cross-game parlay, edge >= 5
strategies.rule: The two strongest T03 legs on a date, if two exist; both must win.

strategies.name: Fade a back-to-back
strategies.rule: Bet against the team on zero full days off when its opponent is not.
strategies.why_tested: the tired-team fade, on a rest layer that now includes the 23 fixtures

strategies.name: Model favourite AND opponent on a back-to-back
strategies.rule: Take the model side only when the team it likes is also the better-rested one.
strategies.why_tested: the combination the site's S5 and S1 would like to be

strategies.name: Recent-form confirmation
strategies.rule: Take the model side only when its last-four margin points the same way.
strategies.why_tested: does recent form add to the season-long rating

strategies.name: Two-leg same-day parlay, edge >= 3
strategies.rule: The two strongest T02 legs on a date, if two exist; both must win.
strategies.why_tested: does the correlation between same-night legs matter once the legs are chosen this way

strategies.name: Over when the projection clears the league mean
strategies.rule: Bet the over when the projected total is above the running league mean total.
strategies.why_tested: totals have no originated opponent line, so the null here is a coin flip by construction

strategies.name: Back the better-rested team (gap >= 2 days)
strategies.rule: Ignore the model; bet whichever team has had two or more extra calendar days between games.
strategies.why_tested: is rest alone a signal at all

strategies.name: Fade 3 games in 4 nights
strategies.rule: Bet against the team with three or more games in the last four calendar days when its opponent has one or fewer.
strategies.why_tested: a denser schedule measure than T06

library_null.statistic: largest standardised excess over the model's own expectation, across the library
library_null.reading: below 0.05 means the best strategy in this library is beyond what a luck-only library of the same size, on the same games and the same model probabilities, would usually produce
